status: Three additional HTTP/PostgreSQL ingress cases verified
scope: One new test target and dated evidence only; production, existing contracts, shared harness, migrations and generated files unchanged
coverage_review: The existing nine-case source was inspected. Its simple active-maintenance status/archive/delete/restore, ordinary title edit, eligible-assignee no-op and position event-failure cases are not rerun here.

new_cases.name: team_move_checks_both_guarded_groups_without_transfer_effects
verified: Actual move preview and HTTP move commands from and into a guarded status group return typed 409 with the one current maintenance entry and applied=false
Both rejections leave complete issue/rank/team/counter/key/document/history/event/link/job/progress/receipt snapshots unchanged; no move receipt is acknowledged or retained
A normal move into a different unguarded status in that same team succeeds, so maintenance does not freeze unrelated groups

new_cases.name: terminal_same_status_noop_preserves_history_and_reopening_requires_assignee_repair
verified: A historical assignee made ineligible through a fixture role change remains recorded and is projected as not assignable
Explicit same-status positioning is a true no-op with unchanged issue/order versions and domain snapshots; one successful idempotency acknowledgement is allowed and checked separately
Reopening returns 422 and rolls back its request receipt and every captured domain effect
Explicitly clearing the assignee through the normal API permits a fresh reviewed reopen with one version increment and unchanged document body/version

new_cases.name: compound_document_status_rejection_is_atomic_and_same_status_text_remains_writable
verified: Compound description plus status-change or archive requests return typed maintenance 409 and preserve complete snapshots, including document body/revisions and receipts
A description edit carrying the unchanged status remains writable during maintenance

The allowed edit advances issue and document versions once, adds exactly one document revision and issue activity entry, and appends exactly one issue.updated plus one document.updated event under one actor/mutation and two stream sequences
The queued normalization guard and staged/applied progress remain unchanged

snapshot_boundary.audit_exclusions: None: guards are seeded as valid queued fixture operations before the measured HTTP requests; these commands do not enqueue or resume maintenance
snapshot_boundary.rank_precision: Issue rank is captured as numeric text rather than a lossy JSON floating-point value
snapshot_boundary.no_op_acknowledgement: The no-op domain comparison excludes only idempotency records, with the exact successful receipt count asserted separately

checks.format: rustfmt --edition 2024 --config skip_children=true on the new target
checks.runtime: The compiled target ran with --test-threads=1 --nocapture in the existing private namespace

environment.fixture: Unchanged shared application Harness::new, current migration 27 and real HTTP router
environment.roles: Existing separate runtime/migration/worker/operator test configuration retained; these new cases exercise the serving role and owner fixture preparation/assertions
environment.data: Synthetic current-version issues are created through HTTP; scoped owner writes prepare valid maintenance guards and historical assignee eligibility
environment.cleanup: The harness cleans its successful fresh schemas; the original cluster/database data remain retained, and PostgreSQL stopped successfully

limits: These are three new cases in one focused run, not a new combined execution of all existing API cases.
Fixture role changes and directly seeded maintenance intents isolate ingress behavior; they do not requalify account management, enqueue/resume or worker capabilities.
Connected UI, integration/hosted checks, native/physical/assistive/performance and whole-product acceptance remain separate.
migration_rollback: Test/evidence only; no new migration, storage-format or runtime rollback is required.
